description: Shift-free low-res on the TF augmentation path (design section 3): --lowres-method nn|tent (default nn = today's NN-down + linear-up, bit-identical; tent = triangle-filtered downsample that is the row-normalised adjoint of the linear upsample, P = U @ D per axis, static n x n matrices). The approved design chose 'tent' over box 'area' because box + linear failed the < 0.02 voxel centroid gate (max ~0.06 voxel); the flag value is therefore `tent`, not `area`. TF only (DALI keeps nn). Independent of FEAT-001/003/004.
steps: data_loading/params.py: LOWRES_METHODS = ("nn", "tent"); add dataclass field `low_res_method: str = "nn"` as the LAST field of IntensityAugConfig (DALI never reads it).

data_loading/tf_intensity_aug.py: add `_tent_matrix(n, f)` building (per design 3.2) m = max(1, floor(f n + 0.5)) in float64, c(o) = (o + 0.5) m / n - 0.5, l0 = floor(c), w = c - l0, l0c = clip(l0, 0, m-1), l1c = clip(l0+1, 0, m-1); U [n, n] float64 = (1-w)[:,None]*one_hot(l0c, n) + w[:,None]*one_hot(l1c, n); a = reduce_sum(U, axis 0); D = transpose(U) * divide_no_nan(1, a)[:, None]; P = U @ D cast to float32 (f is a traced float64 scalar tensor, n static). Add `_apply_axis_matrix(x, P, axis)` = tf.tensordot(P, x, axes=[[1], [axis]]) then tf.transpose back to the original axis order. Add `_lowres_axis_tent(x, axis, f)`. Change signature to `lowres_resample(x, f, roi=None, method="nn")`: method not in P.LOWRES_METHODS -> ValueError; 'nn' runs today's code verbatim (roi honoured); 'tent' ignores roi. In augment_image pass `getattr(cfg, "low_res_method", "nn")` into lowres_resample inside the existing tf.cond; the uniform draw pattern / seeds stay unchanged. Update the module docstring (tent described, paper sentence from design 3.1).
data_loading/intensity_ref.py: numpy reference `lowres_tent_np(img, f)` using explicit Python loops over o and l (independent of the TF matrix code) for spatial axes 0, 1, 2.

runtime/args.py: `--lowres-method {nn,tent}` default nn in the augmentation group; in parse_args: tent with intensity_aug_device(args) == 'dali' -> parser.error('--lowres-method tent needs --intensity-aug-device tf (DALI only has nn)'); with --intensity-aug false accepted, no effect. intensity_aug_tf(args) returns P.IntensityAugConfig(low_res_method=args.lowres_method).
main.py: the 'intensity aug %s' data description (l.~196, `desc`) appends ' | low-res tent' when the TF device is used with tent. No resume guard.

tests/test_tf_intensity_aug.py: 11.2 a (method='nn' == today's output for every ROI in LOWRES_ROIS and f in (0.5, 0.63, 0.8, 0.97, 1.0), max |diff| 0 - compare against the default-argument call), b (tent vs intensity_ref.lowres_tent_np max |diff| < 1e-5 on random (11, 16, 13) and (40, 56, 48)), c (centroid test: shapes (40,56,48) full 3-D and level-1 axes 160/224/192 one axis at a time on [n,4,4] slabs; 0/1 slabs widths {12,16,20} at starts np.linspace(2, n-w-2, 5).round().astype(int); f in np.arange(0.5, 0.951, 0.05): |centroid shift| < 0.02 voxel for tent; nn exceeds 0.1 for at least one case; informational edge slab start 0 width 12: tent shift < 0.07), d (sum preserved rtol 1e-5, constant image constant to 1e-6, f=1 returns input max |diff| 0), e (inside tf.function with a tensor f: output shape == input shape, one trace for 3 different f), unknown method -> ValueError.

tests/test_main.py (or the args test module already covering intensity flags): 11.2 f parser cases: tent + --intensity-aug-device dali -> SystemExit (parser.error); tent + tf -> train_config_from_args(args).intensity_aug_tf.low_res_method == 'tent'; default 'nn'. Optionally extend tests/test_trainer.py::TestTFIntensityAug with one short step using IntensityAugConfig(low_res_prob=1.0, low_res_method='tent') to show it runs inside the Trainer post-process (finite loss).
acceptance_criteria: tests.test_tf_intensity_aug passes incl. new tests; tent centroid gate < 0.02 voxel on the specified grid; nn path max |diff| 0 vs today
